description.en:
DIRECTV TECH PROTECT offers premium coverage for a wide variety of home tech devices like TVs, audio and streaming devices, desktop and laptop computers, tablets, smart home accessories and more.

DIRECTV TECH PROTECT coverage includes setup, troubleshooting, and home wi-fi optimization, all available upon plan activation. 

The DIRECTV TECH PROTECT app is also available upon plan activation to quickly register covered devices. Terms apply.  For more information, refer to directv.com/techprotect.

descriptionsByKey.long-partner:
The English And Spanish channels you love in one package-100+ live TV channels, including 55+ in Spanish, And 40+ in English. Get robust Spanish-language And English programming for the whole family. Watch news, movies, live entertainment, sports, music, And children’s programming.

Plus Tax. Price for 24 months plus taxes and fees with 24-month agreement. Advanced Receiver Service Fee $15/mo. is extra & applies.
descriptionsByKey.long-myatt: DIRECTV: Compatible device req'd. Residential U.S. customers only (excludes Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands). Your DIRECTV service renews monthly at the prevailing rate, charged to your payment method on file unless you cancel. Once you've canceled, you can access DIRECTV through the remaining monthly period. New customers who cancel service in the first 14 days will receive a full refund. Otherwise, no refunds or credits for any partial‐month periods or unwatched content. Returning customers who disconnected service within the previous 12 months are not eligible for a refund. Regional Sports & Local Channels: Regional Sports available with CHOICE and above. Not available in select areas. Channels vary by package & billing region. Device may need to be in billing region in order to view. Limits: Offers may not be available through all channels and in select areas. Programming subject to blackout restrictions. Subject to DIRECTV terms and conditions (see directv.com/LegalStream). Pricing, channels, features, and terms are subject to change & may be modified or discontinued at any time without notice. See directv.com/stream/ for details.
